items.name: wave.record_digests
items.proposal: One immutable ROOT receipt cell per record; no per-wave growing map. Full fingerprint+source ordinal+wave+generation; committed cursor determines applied, receipt existence alone never means applied.

items.name: cohort.wave_keys
items.facts: summary.mjs emits wave_keys in nonmaterialized summary. materialized counters() whitelist omits it; scalar replace() stores descriptor/counters only. contribution() summary sees one independent wave.
items.proposal: No removal/extra writer needed. Preserve existing scalar cohorts in same atomic aggregate.

items.name: aggregate.pending_deadlines
items.proposal: ROOT external bounded maturity queue + one bounded aggregate.maturity_pending durable intent; queue exact-readback ack before next fold. Old maps untouched.

items.name: aggregate.instrument_assets
items.proposal: ROOT immutable instrument->asset point cell; CAS create/readback before fold, mismatch fail; old maps untouched.
